name: @compass/workspace
description: Compass workspace root. Coordinates the bun workspace (one root bun.lock + hoisted node_modules) and pins shared dependency versions via the catalog. proto (.prototools) owns the bun/node toolchains; this catalog owns the shared package versions. The overrides are reviewed floors/pins, not floats: @tanstack/virtual-core 3.17.5 is the chat-mode scroll floor the message-surface renderer requires. The codegen plugins are not here — buf and every plugin it invokes come from the pinned nixpkgs (devenv.nix), so the version stamped into each generated header is a store path rather than a lockfile resolution.
